description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: sofa along right wall facing left toward TV/dining; armchair seating near centre. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families needing multiple bedrooms; people who work from home requiring a dedicated desk or office space; anyone with mobility issues navigating the narrow elongated layout; households needing abundant natural light in the bedroom.
